listing.name: Monster Hunter Tri — OceanTriRecomp (krisztsa)
listing.summary: Upstream presents a native game runtime with integrated graphics, controls and save management; this README does not give a complete-playthrough result. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own RMHP08 .iso or .rvz. Select or extract the image using the runtime setup. Original assets are still needed; upstream says its downloads do not contain the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README declares author-published compiled releases and v1.9.0; use the official runtime package and supply the owned image in its setup. Source alternative: CMake 3.22+, Ninja and C++20 Clang or Visual Studio 2022. Setup is not described as recompiling the game locally.

warnings: Upstream presents a native game runtime with integrated graphics, controls and save management; this README does not give a complete-playthrough result.
